title: Whole Counsel of God
definition: The Whole Counsel of God means the full teaching of Scripture should be received, taught, and obeyed without avoiding truths that are difficult or unpopular.
summary: The Whole Counsel of God means the full teaching of Scripture should be received, taught, and obeyed without avoiding truths that are difficult or unpopular.
christFocus: Jesus fulfilled all Scripture and sends His people to teach all that He commanded, not only the parts that are easy to receive.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The whole counsel of God means believers need the full witness of Scripture. God’s people should not build faith from favorite verses alone while avoiding teachings about sin, judgment, holiness, suffering, repentance, obedience, mission, and hope.

Faithful teaching includes comfort and correction, promise and warning, grace and truth. The whole Bible is profitable because the whole Bible is God’s Word.

Christ is revealed through the whole counsel of God. The Bible’s full message shows why sinners need Him, who He is, what He accomplished, how His people live, and where history is going under His reign.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often want Scripture to confirm what they already prefer. The whole counsel of God protects believers from selective faith that receives comfort but rejects correction.

This doctrine also guides pastors, teachers, and ministries. Faithfulness means teaching what God has spoken, not only what draws attention or avoids discomfort.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Commit to receiving the whole Word of God with humility. Do not skip hard passages or unpopular truths. Let Scripture comfort, confront, correct, and equip you so your life is shaped by God’s full counsel in Christ.
